crossRefs.note: He cried and said, ‘Father Abraham, have mercy on me, and send Lazarus, that he may dip the tip of his finger in water…

translations.web: ‘where their worm doesn’t die, and the fire is not quenched.’
translations.kjv: Where their worm dieth not, and the fire is not quenched.
translations.asv: where their worm dieth not, and the fire is not quenched.
